content.title:
5 mistakes to avoid
*in the exam hall.*
content.subtitle: Most lost marks are not about knowledge. They are about habits under time pressure.

steps.title: Getting stuck on one question
steps.detail: If a question takes too long, mark it and move on. Come back only if time is left.

steps.title: Skipping the instructions
steps.detail: Read the marking scheme and section rules on the paper before you start, every time.

steps.title: Long calculations first
steps.detail: Do the quick wins first. The long DI set can wait until you have banked easy marks.

steps.title: Guessing blindly
steps.detail: Where wrong answers cost marks, guess only when you can rule out options.

steps.title: No time check
steps.detail: Decide checkpoints now, for example where you should be at the halfway mark.
